scope: Authored reference generation history. Each reference must be visually reviewed, independent of successful generation.

entries.prompt: Generate a pristine exceptionally legible engineering-style assembly reference plate GT01 D05 / DUAL RAIL WINDOW REGULATOR / ASSEMBLY R1. Use the THREE supplied individual-part sheets as strict shapes: tall narrow pressed zinc steel U-section rail with two round end pulley holes, two web slots and both ears on one edge; cream polymer carriage with four corner slots central circular opening diagonal front ribs and cable nipple sockets top/bottom; black cable drum with actual helical grooves, six-lobed through drive hole, six shallow end ribs. Two parallel rails 900 mm apart horizontally, both 446 mm tall, four black 54 mm pulleys at rail top and bottom. Front rail left has both ears LEFT; rear right rail has both ears RIGHT. Four physically identical pulleys. Both carriages halfway up the rails. Black cable drum below centre between rails; compact dark gearbox behind drum and silver cylindrical DC motor pointing right. Rectangular shaped glass clamps bolt to both carriage centres. Not an X-scissor lift. Six large panels, visually detailed no crowded illegible lists: 1 FRONT assembled orthographic, 2 REAR assembled orthographic, 3 large ISOMETRIC fully assembled, 4 EXPLODED in logical layers with matching same components and fine dashed alignment axes: rails, 4 pulleys, 4 one-piece rivet pins, 8 annular washers, 2 carriages, 2 glass clamps, three separate cable loops and their outer sheaths, drum, lower housing, cover, compact motor/gearbox; 5 CLEAR CABLE ROUTING in restrained blue/red/gray highlighting three independent paths: lower cable drum to front lower pulley to front carriage; intermediate cable front carriage to front upper pulley to rear lower pulley to rear carriage; upper cable rear carriage to rear upper pulley back to drum. The crossing sheaths are offset in depth by a separator, never cut through each other. 6 enlarged ACTUAL ASSEMBLY JOINT of carriage hooked plastic profile wrapping around metal return lips, alongside correct pulley axial sequence rivet head / washer / pulley / washer / rail / formed tip same rivet. All six panels show consistent counts and shapes. Same front and rear orthographic silhouettes mirrored correctly. Fine neutral gray technical line work with realistic zinc nylon rubber material cues on white; high clarity at zoom. Major labels P01 P02 P03 P04 P05 P10 P11 P12 P14 P15 only, not microscopic text. Footer AUTHOR DESIGN / GEOMETRY AND ASSEMBLY REFERENCE / NOT MEASURED OEM DATA.
entries.review: rejected: front/rear duplication, inconsistent ids and rivet representation

entries.prompt: Edit FIRST supplied six-panel carriage sheet to R4. The incorrect panel 5 shows two separate blue I-like rails. REPLACE ALL OF PANEL FIVE with the EXACT cross-section topology from SECOND supplied actual-mesh-section diagram: ONE continuous blue stamped U rail under the cream carriage, U base continuous across bottom, both metal lips turn INWARD near top. Cream carriage plate is ABOVE the rail, central through-hole splits the section of that front plate; two cream hooked walls hang OUTSIDE the metal left/right flanks and curl UNDER the rail outer back corners. White clearance remains between every metal/plastic pair. The cream hook is NOT inside the metal U and do not invent a second rail. Use precisely the second diagram outlines, just finer engineering drafting hatch style. Label SECTION A-A / CARRIAGE MID-TRAVEL, small note 'blue: ONE rail / cream: ONE carriage'. Preserve panels1,2,3,4 shapes, corner holes, central hole, nipple sockets and diagonal ribs. ALSO correct panel6 to show the same OUTSIDE WRAP interface in a clear cutaway isometric, consistent with second diagram; don't show steel passing through plastic. Background white, entire border and six panels remain complete, footer GT01 D05-P03 / FRONT SLIDING CARRIAGE / R4. This is author design, no dimensional certification.
entries.review: partial adoption; panel6 still under review

entries.prompt: Create an exceptionally clear standalone six-view part reference drawing GT01 D05-P11 / CABLE DRUM LOWER HOUSING / R1. Interior genuinely hollow, 2.8 mm cylindrical sidewall, rear floor thickness3 mm and centre shaft through-hole diameter20.4 mm. Outer structural ribs join ear bases to circular cup. Both windows are real open ports with surrounding wall; no solid plug or impossible blind recess. Front view looks INTO open cup and sees rear central through-hole and back internal ribs.
